answer: Sybil farms shrink if each established identity can sponsor only a handful of newcomers into a public garden of probationary accounts, posting a burnable bond for each. The nominee's first few attested answers stay on-chain as a relic fingerprint. Later submissions are compared to that fingerprint and to other nominees of the same sponsor; a tight duplicate cluster is marked umber on the settlement board and burns the bond, capping how many empty identities one operator can float without losing trusted stake.
